data.name: Quadir
data.gender_notes: Quadir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who possesses power, strength, and mastery over a situation or people. The name Quadir carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful, Master” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Quadir usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful, master and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who strive for mastery over their own souls and seek to lead others to spiritual enlightenment.
data.etymology: Quadir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Powerful, Master.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Quadir total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: قدر
in_arabic.meaning: Powerful, Capable, Masterful, Sovereign, Lord, Ruler, King
in_arabic.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'q-d-r' which means power, capability, mastery, sovereignty, lordship, and rulership. It is often used to describe someone who is powerful, capable, and in control. The name Quadir can be translated to English as powerful, capable, masterful, sovereign, lord, ruler, or king.

data.cultural_impact: The name Quadir beautifully embodies the Arab Islamic culture as it highlights the qualities of being strong, powerful, and masterful. It draws from the noble concept of having the ability to control one's circumstances and destiny, which is a cherished ideal in Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Quadir resonates with the divine attribute of Al-Qudus, meaning the holy one, emphasizing the idea of being pure in intentions and actions. It also serves as a reminder of the ultimate master, Allah, and our reliance upon Him for our strength and power. By embracing the spiritual meaning of the name, individuals are encouraged to strive for mastery over their own self, that of striving to attain inner peace, love, and obedience to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Strong, Powerful, Master" symbolizes One who possesses power, strength, and mastery over a situation or people.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Quadir serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of strong, powerful, master.
